Package dev.px.core.event

Interface Subscription

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface Subscription extends AutoCloseable
Handle to a lambda handler registered via EventBus.on(java.lang.Class<T>, java.util.function.Consumer<? super T>). Closing it removes the handler; closing twice is a no-op.
